title: Monster Mash
intro: [mischievously] Lock the closet doors and check under the bed... because tonight it's the MONSTER MASH! Every category is crawling with Disney monsters and creatures. [laughs] Don't worry, they're more scared of you than you are of them. Mostly.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 spooky-fun title card: a moonlit Victorian graveyard party with glowing jack-o'-lanterns, a cluster of wardrobe doors standing open on a hilltop with colorful light spilling out, bats silhouetted against a giant full moon, swirling green fog, purple and lime color palette, playful not scary, painterly animation style. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: We Scare Because We Care
categories.intro: Our film category is Pixar's 2001 classic Monsters, Inc. [chuckles] Put on your hard hat, we're clocking in on the Scare Floor.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a vast industrial factory floor of colorful bedroom closet doors hanging on a conveyor rail, yellow warning lights, glowing scream canisters stacked on shelves, retro 1960s corporate style, bright teal and magenta. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: At the start of Monsters, Inc., the city of Monstropolis is powered by collecting these from human kids.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is screams! [gasps] But by the end, they discover laughter is TEN times more powerful. Mike was born for that job.

clues.clue: Mike Wazowski is head over heels for this snake-haired receptionist.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Celia! [laughs] Her hair literally hisses at you. Googley bear, I'm sorry.

clues.clue: This purple, chameleon-like Scarer can blend into his surroundings and is Sulley's biggest rival.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Randall Boggs! [sarcastic] Such a nice guy... who built a giant scream extractor. He ends up banished, getting whacked with a shovel.

clues.clue: This crab-legged CEO of Monsters, Inc. turns out to be in on the evil scream extractor plot.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Henry J. Waternoose! [dramatic pause] I'll kidnap a thousand children before I let this company die. Not exactly employee of the month.

clues.clue: Monster George Sanderson sets off a 2319 alert when he returns from the human world with this stuck to his fur.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a sock! [laughs] The Child Detection Agency tackles him and shaves him bald. Poor George. Twenty three nineteen! We have a twenty three nineteen!

categories.title: Creature Feature
categories.intro: Creature Feature: big ones, small ones, scaly ones and blue ones. [excited] Name these Disney monsters and creatures!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a misty enchanted forest clearing with mysterious creature footprints in the mud, glowing eyes peeking from the dark undergrowth, scattered scales and a single glowing feather, lush greens with fiery orange accents. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Stitch is officially known by this experiment number.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is six twenty-six! [chuckles] Experiment six twenty-five, Reuben, just wants to make sandwiches. Very relatable.

clues.clue: In Luca, sea monsters magically turn human whenever they get this way.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is dry! [whispers] Which makes a rainy day in Portorosso VERY dangerous. Silenzio, Bruno!

clues.clue: In Moana, this fiery lava monster blocks the way to the island of Te Fiti.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Te Kā! [gasps] Plot twist: Te Kā IS Te Fiti, without her heart. Honestly, I'd be grumpy too.

clues.clue: In Frozen, Elsa conjures up this giant snow monster bodyguard to chase Anna and Kristoff away.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Marshmallow! [laughs] A terrifying ice giant... named after a fluffy campfire snack. VERY intimidating.

clues.clue: In Fantasia's Night on Bald Mountain, this enormous winged demon summons ghosts from the graveyard.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chernabog! [dramatic pause] Animated by the legendary Bill Tytla. Easily the most terrifying thing Disney has ever put on screen. Sweet dreams!

categories.title: Monster Rhyme Time
categories.intro: [mischievously] It's Rhyme Time, monster edition! Every answer is two words that rhyme. I'll describe it, you rhyme it.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a mad-science kitchen counter with bubbling cauldrons, a giant sandwich with too many layers, a plate of spaghetti, a ticking alarm clock, all arranged in playful pairs under spooky green lab lights. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: An annoying rash on Experiment 626
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stitch itch! [laughs] Somebody get that little blue guy some lotion.

clues.clue: A huge dinner party thrown at the castle of Belle's furry prince
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beast feast! [excited] Lumiere would be THRILLED. Be our guest!

clues.clue: The thing Captain Hook's ticking crocodile swallowed
clues.reveal: The correct answer is croc clock! [chuckles] Tick tock, Captain. That alarm clock never gets snoozed.

clues.clue: Pasta night for the snow-cone-making snowman banished to the Himalayas in Monsters, Inc.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is yeti spaghetti! [laughs] Abominable? Never. He's an excellent host. Lemon snow cone for dessert?

clues.clue: A deli sandwich for the burlap sack boogeyman of The Nightmare Before Christmas
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oogie Boogie hoagie! [sighs] Hold the bugs, please. He's literally made of them.

categories.title: Haunts and Howls
categories.intro: Haunts and Howls takes us to the spookiest attractions in the Disney parks. [whispers] Keep your arms and hands inside the doom buggy at all times.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a moody Southern antebellum mansion on a hill at night, twisting wrought iron gates, a crooked stretching portrait gallery, a crystal ball glowing on a seance table, cobwebs and candelabras, deep purple and ghostly teal. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Haunted Mansion is said to be home to 999 of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is happy haunts, or ghosts! [mischievously] There's always room for one more... any volunteers?

clues.clue: At Disney's Hollywood Studios, this ride drops you down an elevator shaft in a haunted 1930s hotel.
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror! [gasps] The drops are randomized, so you NEVER know what's coming. Check out is... never.

clues.clue: Expedition Everest at Animal Kingdom sends you racing away from this legendary creature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the yeti! [chuckles] The guardian of the mountain. The Monsters, Inc. yeti would never do that to you.

clues.clue: In the Haunted Mansion, this disembodied head floats inside a crystal ball summoning the spirits.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Madame Leota! [dramatic pause] Serpents and spiders, tail of a rat... call in the spirits, wherever they're at. Little Leota says goodbye at the exit.

clues.clue: The Haunted Mansion's three hitchhiking ghosts are Ezra, Phineas, and this short, bearded prisoner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gus! [laughs] Ezra is the tall skinny one, Phineas has the top hat, and Gus drags his ball and chain. Beware of hitchhiking ghosts!

categories.title: Scary Good Songs
categories.intro: Club DJ chose Scary Good Songs: the spookiest tunes Disney ever wrote. [excited] Feel free to sing along. Badly. I won't judge.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a gloomy graveyard stage at midnight with a pipe organ made of bones, musical notes drifting like ghosts, a spotlight on an empty microphone, a crescent moon, playful black and orange palette. No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: The Nightmare Before Christmas opens with Halloween Town performing this song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is This Is Halloween! [mischievously] Boys and girls of every age, wouldn't you like to see something strange?

clues.clue: The singing busts in the Haunted Mansion's graveyard perform this spooky tune.
choices: Yo Ho, A Pirate's Life for Me
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Grim Grinning Ghosts! [laughs] The grim grinning ghosts come out to socialize. Thurl Ravenscroft is one of those singing busts, by the way.

clues.clue: In Beauty and the Beast, Gaston leads the villagers to storm the castle singing this song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Mob Song! [dramatic pause] Kill the Beast! Easily the darkest sing-along in the Disney canon.

clues.clue: Moana's glam crab Tamatoa shows off his treasure-covered shell in this song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shiny! [sarcastic] He's a humble crab... said nobody ever. Jemaine Clement's David Bowie vibes are unmatched.

clues.clue: In this 1929 cartoon, the very first Silly Symphony, skeletons dance and play each other's bones in a graveyard.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Skeleton Dance! [chuckles] Ninety plus years later, still the original spooky scary skeletons. Ub Iwerks animated most of it himself.
